body.name: moment-envelope-clipped partial-history importance-weighted estimator
body.construction:
For \(0\le k<T\), define
\[
 \widehat\theta_k:=\operatorname{clip}_{[-M_1,M_1]}
 \left\{\frac1{T-k}\sum_{t=k+1}^{T}Z_t(k)\right\},
 \qquad
 Z_t(k):=Y_t\prod_{j=t-k}^{t}\rho_j,
\]
with the zero-cell convention in the definition of \(\rho_t\).  This is the componentwise observable map for every supplied design \(D\).
